explanation: The risen Messiah whom God has made both Lord and Savior, whose name brings healing and reconciliation with God.
Physical or spiritual restoration of health, here demonstrated through God's power in Jesus' name on a lame man at the Temple gate.
The Almighty Creator who exalted Jesus and gave him the power to save his people from the power of sin.
Humanity's turning away from God's will, which requires repentance so that sinners may be blotted out of the book of death.
A profound change of heart and mind where people turn away from sin and back to God to receive life.
Servants who spoke on God's behalf before Jesus came, foretelling the Messiah's sufferings and his victory over death.
The entrance to the holy place in Jerusalem where the lame man was healed, symbolizing openness for all believers.
